lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The sun has not risen in a hundred days. The last towns huddle around their hearths, and the hearths are going out.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: At Ashen Hearth, one wagon is ready to leave.

lines.speaker: mira
lines.text: This is the last true flame. It was lit in Solenne, and Solenne is where it has to go.

lines.speaker: oren
lines.text: It's so small.

lines.speaker: mira
lines.text: It's young. So were we all, once.

lines.speaker: mira
lines.text: Bram, hold the line. Lysa, watch the road. Oren, keep them standing. Kit... try not to steal anything.

lines.speaker: kit
lines.text: No promises.

lines.speaker: ember
lines.text: ...crackle...

lines.speaker: mira
lines.text: Keep it fed. Keep it moving.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The Rootmother falls, and the fireflies drift back into the trees.

lines.speaker: lysa
lines.text: The woods are quiet. Too quiet.

lines.speaker: ember
lines.text: ...far... so far... the cold is waiting...

lines.speaker: bram
lines.text: Did that thing just speak?

lines.speaker: mira
lines.text: It's frightened. It says the road gets colder from here.

lines.speaker: oren
lines.text: You understood it? I've tended flames my whole life. They don't speak.

lines.speaker: mira
lines.text: This one does. You only have to have listened long enough.

lines.speaker: mira
lines.text: Come on. The dunes won't cross themselves.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Past the Colossus, a stone marker leans out of the glass, worn smooth by three hundred years of wind.

lines.speaker: lysa
lines.text: There are names carved here. Drivers of the old caravans.

lines.speaker: kit
lines.text: Hey, Mira. This one's yours. Same spelling and everything.

lines.speaker: mira
lines.text: A common name, in the old days.

lines.speaker: lysa
lines.text: It's carved in your hand, Mira. I've seen you mark the maps.

lines.speaker: ember
lines.text: ...she was here... she was here before...

lines.speaker: mira
lines.text: The pass is ahead. We should reach it before the light goes.

lines.speaker: bram
lines.text: She didn't answer the question.

lines.speaker: oren
lines.text: No. She didn't.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Under the dead aurora, the caravan makes its last camp before Solenne.

lines.speaker: mira
lines.text: You deserve the truth before the gates. I was the Ember, once. The one before this one.

lines.speaker: mira
lines.text: Three hundred years ago I took this shape to guide the last caravan home. I've driven the road ever since, waiting for a new flame strong enough to make it.

lines.speaker: oren
lines.text: The rite of relighting. An Ember has to give itself to the brazier.

lines.speaker: mira
lines.text: Yes. And this one is too young. It would go out, and Solenne with it.

lines.speaker: ember
lines.text: ...no... don't... I can do it...

lines.speaker: mira
lines.text: I know you can, little one. Not yet. So I'll go in your place.

lines.speaker: kit
lines.text: There has to be another way. There's always another way.

lines.speaker: bram
lines.text: Then we get you to the brazier, and we make it count.

lines.speaker: mira
lines.text: That's all I've ever asked. Keep it moving.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The Hollow King is ash. Before them stands the great brazier, cold for three hundred years.

lines.speaker: mira
lines.text: Don't look so grim. I've been waiting a long time to be warm.

lines.speaker: mira
lines.text: Oren, teach it the rites. Bram, keep it safe. Lysa, Kit, show it the road.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Mira steps into the brazier. For a moment she is only light.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Then Solenne burns. Gold runs down the ruined towers, and far away, a sunrise.

lines.speaker: lysa
lines.text: Look. On the wagon.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Where the young Ember sat, a small girl with Mira's eyes is holding the reins.

lines.speaker: mira_child
lines.text: Well? The world's still dark out there.

lines.speaker: mira_child
lines.text: Keep it moving.
